source: class Part : NeoObject { public int Rank = 0; }

class Parent : NeoObject { public override List<NeoObjectBase>? Children = [new Part { Name = "Sprite" }]; public Part SelectFirstSprite() { if (this.Children.FirstOrDefault((c) => c.Name == "Sprite") is not Part so) { throw new NeoError("Missing sprite"); } return so; } }

NeoVariant<Parent> Lambda = new(initialize: () => new Parent(), childOverrides: [new NeoAnimationChildOverride<Part>(() => { if (this.Children.FirstOrDefault((c) => c.Name == "Sprite") is not Part so) { throw new NeoError("Missing sprite"); } return so; }, new Partial<Part> { Rank = 8 })]);
NeoVariant<Parent> Method = new(initialize: () => new Parent(), childOverrides: [new NeoAnimationChildOverride<Part>(this.SelectFirstSprite, new Partial<Part> { Rank = 8 })]);
NeoVariant<Parent> Wrapper = new(initialize: () => new Parent(), childOverrides: [new NeoAnimationChildOverride<Part>(() => this.SelectFirstSprite(), new Partial<Part> { Rank = 8 })]);

class Probe { public static int LambdaResult() { return Parent.Variants.Lambda.Initialize().SelectFirstSprite().Rank; } public static int MethodResult() { return Parent.Variants.Method.Initialize().SelectFirstSprite().Rank; } public static int WrapperResult() { return Parent.Variants.Wrapper.Initialize().SelectFirstSprite().Rank; } public static int ApplyResult() { var parent = new Parent(); parent.ToVariant(Parent.Variants.Method); return parent.SelectFirstSprite().Rank; } }
